tools.name: load_backend_unslop_rules
tools.description: Returns the full backend-unslop ruleset. Call before writing code if the backend-unslop skill is not already loaded.

tools.name: audit_backend_slop
tools.description: Deterministically scans backend and SQL files for slop: SELECT *, SQL interpolation, N+1 queries, UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE, silent error handlers, type escapes, stack leaks, hardcoded secrets, disabled TLS, weak password hashing, insecure tokens, injection, unverified JWTs, missing timeouts, unbounded queries and TODO placeholders. Accepts files or directories; with no files it audits the git working-tree changes. Suppress a verified false positive with a `unslop-ignore RULE_ID -- reason` comment on or above the line.

files.description: Workspace-relative files or directories. Omit to audit git changes.

tools.name: verify_backend_compile
tools.description: Auto-detects and runs compiler/type/syntax checks: TypeScript (tsc --noEmit), Go (go vet), Rust (cargo check), Python (py_compile), PHP (php -l), Ruby (ruby -c). Missing toolchains are reported as SKIPPED.

projectRoot.description: Relative dir containing project config (tsconfig.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml; default '.')

files.description: Optional modified files; enables per-file checks (Python, PHP, Ruby)

tools.name: verify_typescript_compile
tools.description: Alias of verify_backend_compile, kept for backwards compatibility.

projectRoot.description: Relative dir containing project config (tsconfig.json, go.mod, Cargo.toml, pyproject.toml; default '.')

files.description: Optional modified files; enables per-file checks (Python, PHP, Ruby)
